strings.d1.s0.name: Rynek Główny
strings.d1.s0.tips: Europe's largest medieval square. The St Mary's trumpet call (hejnał) breaks off mid-note every hour.
strings.d1.s1.name: St. Mary's Basilica
strings.d1.s1.tips: Veit Stoss's wooden altarpiece opens at 12:00. The tower costs 15 PLN.
strings.d1.s2.name: Rynek Underground Museum
strings.d1.s2.tips: Medieval Krakow beneath the square. Multimedia displays, closed Tuesdays, book online.
strings.d1.s3.name: Przystanek Pierogarnia
strings.d1.s4.name: Wawel Royal Castle & Cathedral
strings.d1.s4.tips: The royal castle. State Rooms are 35 PLN (online); the cathedral with the Sigismund Bell and royal tombs is 25 PLN. Dragon's Den too; the courtyard is free.
strings.d1.b0.name: Bar Mleczny Pod Temidą
strings.d1.b0.tips: A milk bar (bar mleczny) on Grodzka: cheap Polish home cooking.
strings.d1.b1.name: Collegium Maius
strings.d1.b1.tips: Copernicus's university. Courtyard and clock show at 13:00.
strings.d2.s0.name: Old Synagogue Kazimierz
strings.d2.s0.tips: Poland's oldest synagogue (15th century), now a museum. Szeroka square.
strings.d2.s1.name: Plac Nowy Zapiekanka
strings.d2.s1.tips: Zapiekanka (half-baguette pizza) from the round market hall's windows. Endzior is the classic.
strings.d2.s2.name: Schindler's Factory Museum
strings.d2.s2.tips: Krakow under Nazi occupation. Book online (sells out), restricted entry on Mondays, in Podgórze.
strings.d2.s3.name: Ghetto Heroes Square Chairs
strings.d2.s3.tips: A memorial of 70 empty chairs. Nearby, the Eagle Pharmacy Museum (Pod Orłem).
strings.d2.s4.name: Bernatka Footbridge & Vistula
strings.d2.s4.tips: A suspension footbridge and riverside promenade, then back to Kazimierz.
strings.d2.b0.name: Hamsa Kazimierz
strings.d2.b0.tips: Israeli cuisine and hummus on Szeroka.
strings.d2.b1.name: MOCAK Museum of Contemporary Art
strings.d2.b1.tips: Contemporary art next to the factory. A good option if you have no Schindler ticket.
strings.d3.s0.name: Auschwitz I
strings.d3.s0.tips: 1.5 hours by bus or tour (70 km). A guided tour is MANDATORY between 10:00 and 16:00 (book online weeks ahead, 90 PLN). You will see the 'Arbeit macht frei' gate, the blocks and the gas chamber. Not recommended under 14.
strings.d3.s1.name: Auschwitz II Birkenau
strings.d3.s1.tips: 3 km by shuttle. The ramp, barrack ruins, 1.5 million victims. Keep silence.
strings.d3.s2.name: Oświęcim Town Restaurant
strings.d3.s2.tips: A quiet lunch in town. The Auschwitz Jewish Center (synagogue) is optional.
strings.d3.s3.name: Planty Park Evening Walk
strings.d3.s3.tips: Back in Krakow, walk the park that rings the Old Town. A chance to breathe.
strings.d3.b0.name: Auschwitz Jewish Center
strings.d3.b0.tips: The town's surviving synagogue and museum.
strings.d3.b1.name: Restauracja Starka Kazimierz
strings.d3.b1.tips: Homemade vodka and duck in the evening.
strings.d4.theme: Wieliczka Salt Mine and Nowa Huta
strings.d4.s0.name: Wieliczka Salt Mine
strings.d4.s0.tips: 20 minutes by train. A salt cathedral 135 m underground, chandeliers, 800 steps (lift back up), 14°C. Book online (foreign-language tour about 140 PLN).
strings.d4.s1.name: Karczma Halit Wieliczka
strings.d4.s1.tips: A karczma (inn) by the mine: żurek (sour rye soup) and placki (potato pancakes).
strings.d4.s2.name: Nowa Huta Central Square
strings.d4.s2.tips: A Stalinist ideal city (1949). Take tram 22 to see socialist realist boulevards and the Ark Church.
strings.d4.s3.name: Stylowa Restaurant Nowa Huta
strings.d4.b0.name: Nowa Huta Museum
strings.d4.b0.tips: A bunker and an exhibition on communism.
strings.d4.b1.name: Ogrodowa Wieliczka
strings.d5.s0.name: Krupówki Street Zakopane
strings.d5.s0.tips: 2 hours by bus (FlixBus/Majer). The mountain town's main street, with oscypek (smoked sheep's cheese) stalls.
strings.d5.s1.name: Gubałówka Funicular
strings.d5.s1.tips: 1,120 m. Tatra panorama, hiking in summer, skiing in winter.
strings.d5.s2.name: Karczma Zapiecek Zakopane
strings.d5.s2.tips: A Górale (highlander) inn. Try kwaśnica (sauerkraut soup) and oscypek with cranberry jam.
strings.d5.s3.name: Morskie Oko
strings.d5.s3.tips: The Tatras' 'eye' lake. 9 km paved walk from Palenica (2 hours) or horse-drawn cart; entry 10 PLN.
strings.d5.s4.name: Willa Koliba Museum of Zakopane Style
strings.d5.s4.tips: Witkiewicz's wooden villa and Zakopane architecture. Return bus at 19:30.
strings.d5.b0.name: Kasprowy Wierch Cable Car
strings.d5.b0.tips: Cable car to the 1,987 m summit, instead of Morskie Oko (book online).
strings.d5.b1.name: Bąkowa Zohylina Zakopane
strings.d5.b1.tips: A famous Górale inn with live music.
strings.d6.s0.name: Barbican & Florian Gate
strings.d6.s0.tips: The medieval city gate and barbican. Floriańska Street, the start of the Royal Way.
strings.d6.s1.name: Czartoryski Museum
strings.d6.s1.tips: Da Vinci's Lady with an Ermine and a Rembrandt landscape. Free on Tuesdays.
strings.d6.s2.name: Kościuszko Mound
strings.d6.s2.tips: A 1823 memorial hill with views of the city and the Tatras. Take tram 1 plus a walk; there is a fort museum.
strings.d6.s3.name: Pod Baranem
strings.d6.s3.tips: An Old Town Polish classic: duck and pierogi.
strings.d6.s4.name: Kazimierz Evening at Alchemia
strings.d6.s4.tips: A candlelit Kazimierz bar near Plac Nowy with live jazz.
strings.d6.b0.name: Kraków Zoo & Wolski Forest
strings.d6.b0.tips: A zoo in the forest, instead of the mound.
strings.d6.b1.name: Chimera Salad Bar
strings.d6.b1.tips: A vegetarian buffet on Św. Anny. Cheap.
strings.d7.theme: Vistula morning and a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Wawel Dragon Statue
strings.d7.s0.tips: A dragon that breathes fire every 5 minutes, on the Vistula bank.
strings.d7.s1.name: Vistula Boulevards Walk
strings.d7.s1.tips: The riverside promenade. Coffee boats in summer and views of Wawel.
strings.d7.s2.name: Café Camelot
strings.d7.s2.tips: A bohemian Old Town café. Have the apple charlotte as a farewell.
strings.d7.s3.name: Obwarzanek Stand
strings.d7.s3.tips: Krakow's bread ring (on the UNESCO list), with poppy seeds or salt.
strings.d7.s4.name: Kraków Główny Airport Train
strings.d7.s4.tips: 20 minutes by train to Balice. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Massolit Books & Café
strings.d7.b0.tips: An English-language bookshop café. Try the cheesecake.
strings.d7.b1.name: Manggha Museum
strings.d7.b1.tips: Japanese art across the Vistula, instead of the boulevards.
strings.note0: Tram/bus: a 20-minute ticket is 4 PLN, a day ticket 17 PLN. The Old Town is walkable. The airport train is 17 PLN. For Auschwitz, Wieliczka and Zakopane take a bus or tour (Auschwitz tour 150-200 PLN).
strings.note1: Summer is 22-28°C. Expect Tatra hikes, Vistula boats, Wianki (June) and the Jewish Culture Festival (June-July). Zakopane gets crowded.
strings.note2: Pierogi cost 25-35 PLN, zapiekanka 15, obwarzanek 3, a milk bar meal 20, beer 12. Tip 10%. Poland is cheap and cards are accepted everywhere.
strings.note3: Auschwitz: the online guided tour is 90 PLN and MANDATORY (free entry before 07:30 or in the evening). Not recommended under 14. Book Schindler and Wieliczka online; museums have restricted entry on Mondays.
strings.note4: Wawel State Rooms are timed. The St Mary's altarpiece opens at 12:00. The hejnał sounds to all four directions every hour.
strings.note5: Vodka: żubrówka with apple juice (szarlotka). At night in Kazimierz, head to Plac Nowy.
